title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Central Park DHA 2 Islamabad Part 1
body: The boys from Pindi who drove forty minutes just for this parking lot, phone out before the car's even stopped moving. A bunch of guys standing next to someone's dad's Civic, doors wide open, music on full volume, not even talking to each other, just standing there like it's a car show nobody organized. Someone filming the same TikTok in the parking lot for the fortieth time this week, still hasn't gone viral, still filming it. A guy doing lap after lap around the lot, not lost, just looking for girls and calling it "getting some air." Another guy told his dad he's out for chai with friends, two hours ago, still parked, AC running. Two random guys start arguing about absolutely nothing and somehow there's already a phone out filming before anyone's thrown a punch. The actual DHA 2 residents stopped coming here ages ago, it's not even their park anymore.
caption:
Tag whoever's been "circling" the lot for the third time 😭 Part 2 coming
